post.summary: The Get interface is used for pulling information from a service provider.
A list of information shall be returned from this interface. The list contains identity, status and short description of each information object.
The Get By Link interface is used for pulling information from a data storage handled by the information owner.

get.summary: The purpose of the interface is to provide a dynamic method to ask for the technical status (version and last interaction time) of the specific service instance.

post.summary: The purpose of the interface is to request a public key
The purpose of this interface is to receive a public key

The purpose of the interface is to request subscription on information, either specific information according to parameters, or the information accessible upon decision by information provider.
Specific id on the information object subscription is requested for specific status on the information or specific area of interest

This interface shall be used by the consumer to request removal of subscription.
Specific identity of the information object to remove subscription for. If no id entity provided, all subscriptions for the caller is removed

This interface receives notifications when subscription is created or removed by information producer.
Contains the identity of the information object in focus and type of event; Create or Delete.
The interface shall be used for uploading (pushing) data to a consumer. The operation expects one single data object and its metadata.
The purpose with this interface is to upload (push) a link to information to a consumer.
